nodes.text:
How hMPV Is Treated

Because hMPV commonly clears up on its own, treatment is mostly geared toward easing symptoms. Generally, this means using over-the-counter medications to control pain and fever (such as acetaminophen and ibuprofen), along with a decongestant.

nodes.author: Drmonaafify
nodes.text: Patients with more severe wheezing and coughing may require a temporary inhaler, which may include an inhaled corticosteroid.

nodes.author: Drmonaafify
nodes.text: If you think you are infected, keep others safe by covering your mouth when you cough, avoiding touching and sharing possibly infected items and washing your hands thoroughly.
